Approach: Rebase the feature branch onto main to maintain a linear history.

```bash
# 1. Ensure your local main is up to date with the remote
git checkout main
git pull origin main

# 2. Switch back to your feature branch
git checkout <your-feature-branch-name>

# 3. Rebase your feature branch onto the updated main
git rebase main

# 4. If there are conflicts, resolve them, then continue
# git add .
# git rebase --continue

# 5. Force push the rebased branch to update the remote (required after rebase)
git push --force-with-lease origin <your-feature-branch-name>
```
